correctness.rationale: Normalize B=A/||A|| with spectrum in [0,1]. Positive affine p(t)=2(1+sqrt2)-4t has |t-p(t)^(-1)| <=E by strict concavity, endpoints -E and interior +E, so trial x=p(B)b/||A|| proves the universal bound via functional calculus. For spectral values (0,1/sqrt2,1) and weights (sqrt2-1,sqrt2,1), independently expanded Q(a,c)=||A(aI+cA)b-b||²-E²||(aI+cA)b||² and verified positive-definite quadratic matrix with leading 3-sqrt2 and det (3sqrt2-4)/8>0, zero at (2(1+sqrt2),-4), proving all competitors have error >=E and attainable equality. SPD approximation follows continuity of strictly positive Q_{E-delta} for each delta>0. No randomized check supplies unrestricted proof.
